name: smwgraphics-teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-tournament-fighters-snes-back-alley
title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tournament Fighters (SNES) - Back Alley
description:
Tileset was ripped from the game.

-if you just want to use the BG and that's it, then insert ExGFX37B.bin into your hack, the Map16 file and palette, check the sample file and you're good to go.
-the palettes can be edited, although you have to experiment.
-tileset uses 5 palettes. While that's a lot, you can use this for a boss battle or where you need to kill enemies to advance.
-a palette is used by both the BG and FG.
-BG only uses 61 8x8 tiles and 32 Map16 tiles. It's quite easy. The FG does use 280 Map16 tiles. About the 8x8 tiles, the total for FG is 503 tiles.
-tileset uses some FG2, BG1, FG3, BG2 and BG3 tiles, sparing room for FG1 and FG3.
-no people included, although they take more tiles than needed.
